verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents only online rails for the Secretary of State: the mblsportal filing, search and ordering flows behind a sign-in account, plus online payment. Nothing documents a paper, fax, or mail fallback with mailing addresses, fax numbers, or downloadable filing forms. The single "Find a Form" link belongs to the Department of Revenue site and gives no addresses or submission instructions, so it does not count toward this story.
